item.title: Trump pauses Iran energy plant strikes for 10 days as talks ‘going very well’
item.summary: President paused planned Iran energy plant strikes for 10 days, citing ongoing talks and setting a new April 6 deadline as Operation Epic Fury continues.

item.title: Stephen A Smith tells progressive left to ‘shut the hell up’ over voter ID laws
item.summary: Stephen A. Smith delivered blunt remarks on voter ID laws, calling out progressive critics while also taking aim at President Donald Trump and Gov. Gavin Newsom.

item.title: Heather Graham slams ‘awkward’ new reality of Hollywood sex scenes
item.summary: Heather Graham says intimacy coordinators feel "awkward" on set, sharing candid mixed feelings about the post-MeToo Hollywood practice in a new interview.

item.title: Fox News ‘Antisemitism Exposed’ Newsletter: Harvard 'indifferent to hostility' toward Jewish students: lawsuit
item.summary: Fox News' "Antisemitism Exposed" newsletter brings you stories on the rising anti-Jewish prejudice across the U.S. and the world.

item.title: Judge lets ex-police officer walk after she denied pointing gun at fellow cop who shot her in home standoff
item.summary: Kelsey Fitzsimmons, a former North Andover officer, was found not guilty of assault after testifying she was attempting suicide, not shooting at a cop.

item.title: Department of Education to leave building after 40 years as part of effort to eliminate government agency
item.summary: The Department of Education will be moving offices in an effort to eliminate the agency, according to an announcement from the department.

item.title: LAPD honors Bruce Willis' 90-year-old mother for decades of service to her 'second family'
item.summary: Marlene Willis, Bruce Willis 90-year-old mother, was honored by the LAPD for over two decades of volunteer service at the West LA station.

item.title: Long Island woman missing after jumping from moving vehicle in panicked state
item.summary: A search is underway for a 32-year-old woman who jumped from a moving vehicle and vanished in Long Island last week, her loved ones said.

item.title: Los Angeles schools accused of quietly funding race-based programming for Black students only
item.summary: Defending Education alleges LAUSD officials admitted on a hot mic that a race-based student program never changed after a federal civil rights complaint.

item.title: Mets national anthem singer, who played George Washington in 'Hamilton,' forgets 'Star-Spangled Banner' words
item.summary: From a national anthem flub to knocking out Cy Young winner Paul Skenes, the New York Mets' season opener was a wild, eventful night full of surprises.
